verdict.rationale: Reducto applies AI to user documents inside the product. It does natural-language schema extraction, classification and section splitting, and agentic parse modes accept custom prompts. Studio lets users test these AI-driven workflows on real documents with a citation viewer. However, this output is structured extraction rather than insights or suggestions about the data. Missing for 10: any documented insight generation, summarization or recommendations surfaced in the product UI, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of such a feature.
